author: Gabu
description: Automatically tracks all invite links created in the server and who joins using them.
end_user_data_statement: Stores Discord user IDs of invite creators and members who joined via tracked invites.
install_msg:
Invite tracking is automatic after loading — no setup needed.

**Required Intents:**
- `members` intent (for tracking joins)

**Commands:**
- `[p]invites list` — show all tracked invites
- `[p]invites user [member]` — show a member's invite stats
- `[p]invites clear` — clear all invite data
name: InviteTracking
